EVAL-F5-S158.title: Render Explainability Metadata in Chat UI
EVAL-F5-S158.description: Update frontend MessageBubble and/or ChatWindow components to display explainability metadata (source, meaning, limitations) in a structured and readable format alongside evaluation results without breaking markdown rendering or sanitization.

EVAL-F5-S160.title: Unit Tests for Explainability Generation Logic
